message: Astra: Within Ya na’s scene, does “What if she was wrong?” interrupt the action usefully or repeat what the surrounding sentences already establish? Which passage deserves your limited editing attention? Why would further thought about pacing earn its time over an informative revision now, and what unresolved uncertainty could make revising premature? What textual difference would justify your choice? Can you briefly state your finding, remaining uncertainty, and chosen intention, then carry out that intention in English?
